newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Landec started by Lehman.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Landec started by Lehman.

text.p: -- Lehman said it initiated coverage of Landec Corp with a "V" for venture rating and a 1998 price target of $15 a share.
-- Landec manufactures temperature-activated polymers which change physical characteristics dramatically when passed through a pre-set temperature switch.
-- Analyst James Flicker said in a report the company is focused on six products in three industries for the short-term and at least 200 other product applications long-term.

-- "The risk to Landec is modified (in) that only one of Landec's products is new (the other five are replacement products) and our market penetrations assumptions for the year 2000 are very conservative," the analyst said.
